title: ProdigeUI Theme
description: Schema for ProdigeUI theme files. A theme maps semantic tokens to override values without changing token names.

name.description: Unique theme name (e.g., dark, light, brand-acme).

mode.description: Theme luminance classification: light (background luminance > text luminance) or dark (opposite).

extends.description: Name of the theme to inherit from (fallback source). Defaults to _default if not specified. Set to null for the root theme.

overrides.description: Mapping of semantic token names to override values (primitive token reference or concrete value).

additionalProperties.description: Override value: reference to a primitive token (dot-notation) or a direct value.
